title: The Terrifying Secret of Pirate Flags
hook: Black flag meant surrender; red flag meant everyone dies.

scenes.text: Hollywood movies show pirate ships sailing 24/7 with a flapping Jolly Roger skull flag, but real pirates rarely did.
scenes.imagePrompt: Tall wooden ship mast with furled sails against an overcast grey Atlantic sky with gentle ocean swells. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: Hollywood movies show pirate ships sailing 24/7 with a flapping Jolly Roger skull flag, but real pirates rarely did.

scenes.text: To sneak close to prey, pirate ships flew 'false colors': raising friendly Spanish, French, or British royal naval flags.
scenes.imagePrompt: Signal halyard ropes raising a vibrant red-and-white British naval ensign on the stern flagpole. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: To sneak close to prey, pirate ships flew 'false colors': raising friendly Spanish, French, or British royal naval flags.

scenes.text: Once within cannon range, they lowered the royal flag and hoisted the black Jolly Roger: the universal symbol for 'surrender and live'.
scenes.imagePrompt: Classic black Jolly Roger flag with white grinning skull and crossed bones fluttering menacingly against sea spray. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: Once within cannon range, they lowered the royal flag and hoisted the black Jolly Roger: the universal symbol for 'surrender and live'.

scenes.text: Each captain had custom symbols: Bartholomew Roberts showed himself standing on skulls, while Edward Low used a blood-red skeleton.
scenes.imagePrompt: Embroidered black silk pirate banner with a red hourglass and pierced heart motif on a wooden cabin table. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: Each captain had custom symbols: Bartholomew Roberts showed himself standing on skulls, while Edward Low used a blood-red skeleton.

scenes.text: If a merchant ship dared to fight back, pirates hoisted the dreaded solid crimson red flag: the 'Jolie Rouge', meaning 'No Quarter'—zero survivors.

scenes.voicedText: If a merchant ship dared to fight back, pirates hoisted the dreaded solid crimson red flag: the 'Jolie Rouge', meaning 'No Quarter'—zero survivors.

scenes.text: Seeing that red flag struck sheer panic into every sailor's heart. Would you have surrendered to the black flag immediately?
